description: This file defines the PasswordSecret class, which encapsulates secret credentials information (such as password hashes, plaintext password, salt, and hashing function) for managing password-based secrets within the project. It includes getter and setter methods, validation logic, and encoding functionality for handling passwords securely.

classes.name: PasswordSecret
classes.description: Encapsulates the password and secret management details, including hash function, password hash, plain password, and salt. Provides fluent setters, validity checks, and encoding functionality for secure password handling.

methods.name: getHashFunction
methods.description: Returns the hash function used for password hashing.

methods.name: setHashFunction
methods.description: Sets the cryptographic hash function to use for hashing the password.

methods.name: getPasswordPlain
methods.description: Returns the plain text password (if set).

methods.name: toStringHelper
methods.description: Provides a string representation helper including hashFunction, passwordHash, and salt.

methods.name: checkValidity
methods.description: Validates the secret's state, ensuring necessary fields are present and consistent.

methods.name: encode
methods.description: Encodes the plain password using the provided HonoPasswordEncoder, replacing plain password with hash and salt.
